The '''Taloron Pirate Conflict''' was a guerrilla war fought between the [[Taloron]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups who had bases in that species' [[Taloron system/Legends|Taloron system]] and preyed upon them. After nearly wiping out the Taloron population, the species was forced to abandon its previous existence as mostly peaceful [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] to adopt a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] society. The Talorons staged guerrilla raids against the pirates and their leader, [[Halgir]], and formed a group known as the [[Taloron Hunters]]. The species eventually defeating the pirates and reclaimed the [[Star system/Legends|system]] at some point during the regime of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After the war was finished, however, the Talorons found that they had a warrior society with no one to fight. Several Talorons left the system to find work as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="DoE" />
